description.value: Neptune Palace Seafood is a large-format Chinese seafood restaurant in Vancouver's Marpole neighbourhood, part of a multi-location chain also operating in Surrey and Burnaby. The Vancouver flagship is known for its dim sum service, signature roasted duck preparations, and banquet-style event hosting with space for roughly 200 guests. It is a substantial sit-down destination on the SW Marine Drive corridor, popular for family and group gatherings.
